Hi Samantha / Rajiv —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Cobalt Health is focused on reducing inference cost per API call for model-backed triage, preserving sub-200ms p50 latency for short clinical prompts, and ensuring auditability for patient data access. We recommend a short, targeted walkthrough (30 minutes) that covers:
  - Product demo (platform UX + API examples)
  - Deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
  - Security/compliance overview (SOC 2 logs & retention)

Can you confirm who from your side should join? Based on availability we propose three half-hour windows (all in ET unless noted):
  1) Tue, Jun 24 — 11:00–11:30 ET (08:00–08:30 PT)
  2) Wed, Jun 25 — 14:00–14:30 ET (11:00–11:30 PT)
  3) Thu, Jun 26 — 16:30–17:00 ET (13:30–14:00 PT)

If none of those work, I can open a quick poll or send an invite with a couple of alternates. I attached a one-pager and a draft mutual action plan so you can see a high-level timeline.

Also, any preferences on format (Google Meet vs Teams) and whether we should include an engineering lead for a bit of live Q&A?

Next steps: please reply with preferred window and attendee list (and include any specific compliance docs you want covered). I’ll book and send an invite.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez

(415) 555-0123
